project_name: Doyle's Contracting — 3-Bedroom Custom Walkout Ranch (Full Exposure, 9'/10' Tall Walls, Tray Ceilings)
prototype_notice: PROTOTYPE & ORIGIN NOTE: This software is a digital reconstruction of the paper pre-staging, layout, and bidding workflow I developed and ran at Doyle's Contracting LLC (2015–2021 across 100+ projects). Because I am not actively framing houses full-time today, this app has not yet been field-tested on an active crew; I built it using my current software & data skillset to show how I would deploy, test, and refine my jobsite system in the present day.
daily_goal: Day 2 Goal (Computed from Day 1 Baseline): 2-Man Team frames & bottom-up Tyveks W-2 & W-3; Solo Framer builds W-6 Garage Portal & W-7 Hall Wall; Full Crew hand-lifts exterior walls & sets reverse-staged (LIFO) floor/roof packs.

foundation_rule.action: > 1" OUT OF SQUARE: Adjust field plates. LOCK Kitchens (108-1/2" DW-to-DW / 109-1/2" rough), Bathrooms (60" tub alcoves), and Hallways to 1/8" tolerance. Absorb all variance in Bedrooms and Living/Great Room.
locked_zones: Kitchen Cabinet Runs (1/8" max variance — verify Drywall-to-Drywall + 1" for 1/2" drywall both sides)
Bathroom Tub/Shower Alcoves & Vanity Walls (1/8" max variance — 60" tub pocket must fit tight)
Hallways & Door Trim Clearances (1/8" max variance)
flex_zones: Bedrooms #1, #2, #3 (absorb +/- 1" invisibly without affecting cabinetry or code)
Great Room / Living Room open span (absorb variance outside kitchen cabinet line)

bidding_tiers.rule: Tasks where a 2nd carpenter adds zero speed. Bidded and assigned to 1 experienced guy working off a single sheet.
bidding_tiers.examples: W-6 Front Garage Portal Wall (2.5 hrs), W-7 Interior Door Hallway (2.0 hrs), Chop-Saw Header & Pre-Made Shoulder Batch Bench (3.0 hrs), Stair Stringer Field Measure & Cut (2.5 hrs).

bidding_tiers.rule: Optimal 2-carpenter pair framing complete walls flat on the deck (plates -> studs -> on-deck partition channels -> sheathing -> router openings -> bottom-up shingled Tyvek) or building small porches & gable ends completely on the ground.
bidding_tiers.examples: W-1 Walkout Exposure Wall (5.0 man-hrs), W-2 10' Great Room Wall (4.5 man-hrs), W-3 Master Suite + Tray Soffit (3.5 man-hrs), Ground-Built 8'x4' Front Porch Roof on Concrete Pad + Gable End Complete w/ Tyvek (4.0 man-hrs).

bidding_tiers.rule: Short, high-output pushes where the whole crew comes together: hand-lifting completed exterior walls (faster than waiting on the SkyTrak), setting reverse-staged (LIFO North->South, East->West) 4–6 floor-truss packs, or booming 10+ identical common roof truss runs.
bidding_tiers.examples: Hand-Lift Completed Exterior Walls (15 min per wall), Set 4-6 Pack Floor Trusses (12 picks per 150-truss span), Boom Complete Ground-Built Gable Ends & 8'x4' Porch Roof & Lag to Structure.

PURPLE_RAKE.meaning: Rake / Tray Ceiling Transition — Custom Blocking & Soffit Drop

RED_GOOFY.meaning: GOOFY AREA — Extra Field Framing Knowledge / Check With Lead Before Cutting
